title: Settings page
summary: A sectioned settings form with a sticky Save/Discard bar that appears once a field differs from its last saved value. Set the save(values) callback as a property (business logic, never config data) - it may reject, which shows the error inline instead of saving. Your own content for a section goes in a light-DOM child with slot="section-<key>" (key = that section's config key, for example slot="section-general"): it shows inside the section's card after its fields, so the section nav and the save bar cover it. A control inside it that raises pk-value-change or pk-change marks the form changed; the save callback receives only the config fields. A section with `bare: true` draws no card and no heading: its slot content (and fields) sit directly in the page, so content that draws its own pk-cards is not a card inside a card; the nav item, title bar and save bar still cover it.

props.name: config
props.description: { sections: [{ heading, fields: [{ key, type: 'text'|'email'|'number'|'date'|'textarea'|'select'|'switch'|'range', label, placeholder?, required?, options?, min?, max?, step?, hint? }] }] }. Title bar keys, as on pk-page-header: badges [{ label, variant? }], actionsOverflow, overflowLabel, homeHref, homeLabel, homeIcon. A field's hint (or help) draws an info button beside its label that opens a tooltip; a field without one is unchanged. Each section draws as a pk-card (bare?: true draws none and no heading: the section's fields and slot content sit directly in the page and the app's content draws its own cards; the section still has its nav item and tab, its heading is the label, and the save bar covers it); a select's options are [{ value, label? }] or plain strings; styled?: true on a select draws the themed list, the combobox in select mode, as pk-field-group does; type 'combobox' takes mode?: 'select' | 'autocomplete'. Section nav: nav?: true | false | 'auto' (default 'auto': a list of the sections beside the cards from three sections up; false keeps the plain stack, true forces it at one or two), and each section's key? (its anchor, default a slug of its heading). The list is sticky and marks the section in view with aria-current; choosing one scrolls its card to the top and moves focus onto it; on a phone the list is replaced by pk-detail-layout's tab strip, one section at a time. Optional title bar from the shared page shell: heading?: string, breadcrumb?: [{ label, href? }], actions?: [{ key, label, href?, variant?, hint? }] (a hint shows as a tooltip on the button) (an action without href fires pk-action). Nothing is drawn when none is set.

props.name: values
props.description: The current values, keyed by field key (what save() receives and discard() restores to). Set again once loaded values arrive (e.g. from ctx.store) to refresh the fields and take a new baseline.

events.name: pk-action
events.description: A title-bar action (config.actions entry without an href) was clicked.

parts.name: header
parts.description: The shared title bar: a pk-page-header with the breadcrumb and actions from config. Hidden when config sets none of heading, breadcrumb or actions.

parts.name: saved
parts.description: A success message shown after save(), hidden again once a field changes.

parts.name: empty
parts.description: A placeholder message shown in place of the sections while config.sections is empty.

parts.name: form
parts.description: Wraps the sections and the save bar; submitting it (click Save or Enter) saves.

parts.name: body
parts.description: The grid of the section nav and the cards; carries data-nav while the nav is on.

parts.name: nav
parts.description: The sticky section nav (a nav landmark of pk-nav-item rows); hidden while the nav is off, and on a phone.

parts.name: layout
parts.description: The pk-detail-layout around the cards: on a phone it draws the tab strip of sections.

parts.name: sections
parts.description: Holds one pk-card per config.sections entry.

parts.name: bar
parts.description: The sticky Save/Discard bar; hidden while nothing has changed.

parts.name: status
parts.description: The bar's own message: "Unsaved changes", or a save error.

parts.name: discard
parts.description: The Discard button; restores the last saved values.

cssProperties.name: --pk-settings-page-nav-width
cssProperties.description: Width of the section nav column beside the cards (default 12rem).

a11y: Every field is a labelled real control (pk-input/pk-textarea/pk-select showLabel on, pk-switch's own slotted label, pk-range wrapped in a labelled pk-field); the bar's status uses pk-alert's own role and announcement.

examples.title: Store settings (set config, values and save from script: an inline script cannot run under this site's CSP)
